reviews.text: Good tasty meal. Staff friendly and helpful. However, limited menu compared to other branches I've been to. Very disappointed no Yakisoba dishes. Katsu curry is Katsu curry. Also partner asked for chicken firecracker. She asked for it to be made medium hot with no pakchoi. It arrived 10 to 15 minutes after my meal. No pakchoi but she reckons it was full heat. She still enjoyed it, but not what she asked for. Not the serving staff fault, but not sure what went wrong there. Consequence was we effectively ate separately.

reviews.text: My 3rd time here, this time with a mate who'd never been. Our lunch was as brilliant as the 1st and 2nd time. All the staff are extremely helpful and Peter, our main server was very helpful with the menu and navigating the new app. 2 very happy and full old boys 👍🏻

reviews.author: Cassie McGunnigle
reviews.text: After hearing the hype about Maki and Ramen for so long I was really looking forward to trying with my husband. Well, I was very disappointed. We ordered the chicken karaage and two ramens (one seafood, one steak). The chicken karaage came out within 60 seconds, something I find very concerning and a red flag in any restaurant. I wouldn’t even believe an excuse of “it sits out cooking ready to go”, because when I bit into my first piece it had red pieces, appearing jelly like and under cooked. Batter was also very greasy and thick - more batter than chicken. The ramen was pretty average. Egg looked like it had sat out for a long time with a dried out yoke. The menus and table also didn’t feel very clean. The menu actually felt sticky. Pretty disappointed and certainly won’t be back. Didn’t think it was worth what we paid.

reviews.author: Craig S
reviews.text: First time here. Food: Food was lovely lots of flavour and textures were great. No complaints. Service (Poorest): Waitress was nice and friendly. What put me off the most is I came with my wife and son. We ordered 2 side dishes and 2 mains and a kids bento box. My sons food turned up last. He was so hungry watching me and my wife eat, made me feel incredibly bad and guilty. Had to share ours with him. Atmosphere: Nice decor and music is excellent choice, lots of 80's music not to loud either.

Even though there were plenty of empty tables inside, we were still kept waiting at the door for ages. Surprisingly, such a large restaurant only had two members of staff working during the busy dinner rush. That being said, they both provided great service.

reviews.text: I used to hate sushi, I never understood what people liked about it, but spicy tuna roll has me in tears right now it’s So good 🙏🏽. The atmosphere, the staff all excellent. As you enter you are greeted with the sound of a drum and overall just a great experience highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tasha
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at Maki Soho. My server, Naing, was excellent, friendly, attentive and genuinely lovely. The service was exemplary, and the food was top drawer. The gyoza were great, and the yakisoba was incredibly tasty, as were the other starters prawn tempura, hosomaki and varied Mochi desserts. Everything was delicious and beautifully presented. Excellent offer with Eatclub for a Tuesday afternoon. Would definitely recommend and will be back!

reviews.text: Exceptional! Was served by lovely Imi when we visited the restaurant today. Food and service was excellent. Will definitely be going back again! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jade Friend
reviews.text: Firstly we had to wait a while even though there was loads of empty seats. Look ages to get served, even though there was multiple staff. The food took a while and was not great, It was pretty bland and needed something else. My drink wasn’t too bad but my friends lychee lemonade was ridiculously sweet. When I asked for the bill I also said I had a tastecard code. The guy decided to tell me I should’ve booked to let them know.. I hadn’t had a problem before, plus some places say it on the app, this one didn’t. He never even brought me the bill and decided to keep serving other people. Which I found very rude, I just wanted to leave it was loud from the staff shouting and super hot. I didn’t get the guys name but he was a tall white guy that look like he’d been in a fight all busted up. I had to get someone else to get me the bill. I should’ve refused service charge. Also the toilets were absolutely disgusting. Stunk, tissue everywhere, poo splattered up toilets. Liked like the place was falling apart. There was even a railing coming off the way wall we moved as we went up the stairs. We didn’t notice until my friend grabbed on and almost fell from it coming away. Would not recommend and certainly will not be going back.

reviews.author: Itai Moses (‫אתי‬‎)
reviews.text: We came here as it was half price for food on first table. Glad that we did not pay full price, and not even sure it was worth it with half price off. We got edamame which were clearly heated from frozen, veg gyozas were okay. Veg ramen was okay, the broth was decent but it was mainly just noodles, no veggies or extras. The tofu was meant to be fried tofu but was just soft and plain. Fried chicken was fatty and poor quality meat, cooked from frozen and seemed to be undercooked. Same issue with chicken soba. Boba was nice but served with a tiny straw so you couldn’t even drink it properly! Think based on the reviews this is a tourist trap, but you can get far better quality ramen in London for the price.

Honestly, it just wasn’t enjoyable to eat. Service wasn’t much better — the table was sticky and we waited ages just to pay the bill. Such a shame, as my first visit here was completely different and I really enjoyed it then.

When food finally came the ramen soup dishes we ordered were not the quality of ramen we expect (eating ramen in restaurants many many times). On the plus side the maki rolls were good. We had a 50% discount code which tempered the disappointment, but had we paid full price I might be leaving a somewhat more scathing review.

reviews.author: Uli Stein
reviews.text: Really nice restaurant. The food was very good, and the recommendations of our server, Navin, were on point. If I were to live in London, I would come again.

reviews.author: Akalpa Acharya
reviews.text: TL;DR: Highly recommend! Delicious food and most of the menu is Halal. Ask for Navin, best server ever! What made our experience special was our server Navin. He came and spoke with us as we were settling the bill and honestly, it's been a very long time since I've seen such kindness, authenticity and passion for the role. Navin took the time to ask us about our experience and spoke about how much he loves his job and how Maki & Ramen is a great place to work, because the owner is a kind and wonderful person who really cares about the staff. He spoke about how excited he was when the owner asked him to join the new Shoreditch branch and how he's never known a business owner to be so down to earth and kind, someone who he's personally learnt so much from too. Navin also told us about the charity that the business supports (The Felix Project) and showed us the info leaflet about it. Again, the food is really great but Navin made it a lovely and memorable experience and we hope to see him next time we visit!

reviews.author: Juliana Chukwu
reviews.text: Great service from Navin thanks

reviews.author: Mikołaj Bodziński
reviews.text: Navin was great!

reviews.author: Andrew McKissock
reviews.text: Navin was great. Got me seated rapid and good chat throughout. Answered any questions I had and made sure I was well looked after. Perfect!

reviews.author: Alan Reid
reviews.text: Greasy and lukewarm yaki soba. Warm broth. Mediocre ramen.

reviews.author: Melanie Ngai
reviews.text: I have been to this restaurant twice, with 1 week apart. Both times the service was good. Navin stood out in service, very helpful and friendly. On my first visit, the food was disappointing. The Steak Tataki Raman had 4 thin small slices of steak and they were well done not rare, so a little chewy. The sushi rice in the volcano roll and soft shell crab roll was over cooked, they were like sticky rice, not nice at all. 2nd visit, the sushi rolls rice was as expected. We really enjoyed our food in our 2nd visit. The chef must had an off day on our 1st visit.

reviews.author: Amman Meah
reviews.text: My server Navin was great, sashimi was good, tempura squid tasted like rubber. Mainly annoyed about the fact their bookings started from 3:45, I booked a table for 4pm the day before, arrived, and the restaurant was closed. Terrible work from them to accept bookings when they’re not even open.

reviews.author: Randal Boyle
reviews.text: Poor service, bad ramen, bad sushi and bad drinks. The place was understaffed but really isn’t worth a visit

reviews.author: Shreena Soomarah
reviews.text: Waited 10 minutes for someone to acknowledge we were waiting, even though we had reserved. Had to steal cutlery because nobody brought us any. No condiments on the table besides soya sauce. Tempura was thick and floury - not tempura. The only good part of the ramen was the broth and we had to wait 40 minutes for it. It soon became clear that this place has no interest in being a Japanese restaurant. If you’re into appearances and eat your maki with a fork and dip it into your ramen (as we saw) this is the place for you. Even Wagamama or yo sushi are better. If you want a good Japanese restaurant for the same price go to Sanjugo. If you want fusion go to Uba. If you have more money than sense and need to be warned that you’ll be fined if you vape in the toilets (who does that???) this is the place for you.

reviews.author: Ofra
reviews.text: Just ate here. Fish is not fresh. Some of the worst sushi I’ve ever had. Staff made multiple mistakes on our order. Handed me cutlery that they had fingered all over the side you eat with. Had to ask multiple times for a teaspoon and bowl for my child and was forgotten by three Separate staff members. My bill was wrong and overcharged. The waitress tried to get me to get the lunchtime deal when it came time to pay, but I pointed out to her that that would actually cost me more. Manager asked me if everything was okay, I explained to him our experience, And I got nothing but an apology and “hope to see you next time”. Staff need extra training for sure. Do not eat here, you’re better off going to the High Street for sushi or even yo sushi.

reviews.author: Lib
reviews.text: Was a bit disappointed with how the food was. Ordered a chicken firecracker ramen and steak ramen and with the chicken one being 16 pound it had only about 3 pieces of chicken in it and not much flavor. Steak was somewhat better as it came with more portion of steak. Initially our server told us they were out of steak ramen and we were going to leave but then another staff member said they did have it and fixed our order for us so that atleast worked out. Overall it’s a nice built restaurant but the prices don’t match the quality of the food at all. They should also communicate that the 5 pound ramen is only one per table as it’s providing false advertisement thinking both people can get ramen for 5 pound.

reviews.author: Fariha Choudhury
reviews.text: Amazing service and atmosphere. Food came quick and was great

reviews.author: Amelia
reviews.text: Despite how busy it got yesterday, I overall had such an amazing experience at Maki and Ramen. We were served by Charlotte W, she was such a natural at her job, even though it was busy she still made time to check back on us and was always smiling, she was such a gem! 💕 She did give us amazing recommendations as I was disheartened they didn’t have any of the steak left later in the evening but that’s just another excuse to come back to try! The black garlic tonkotsu and the laksa chicken are definitely worth a try and were a good substitute. Thanks again Charlotte for giving us the best service possible! Also thanks to all the other staff who were working yesterday, they were all working hard to ensure we had an amazing experience. Will be returning again soon.

reviews.author: mina
reviews.text: Unfortunately, we were disappointed with our experience at Maki & Ramen Birmingham. We waited around an hour for our food, and only half the order arrived initially. We had to ask for the rest of our food and drinks, then waited ages again to pay and leave. I’ve never experienced such a bad service before. The music was also far too loud and overstimulating. The food was okay overall, with the sushi being the highlight, but the noodle broth arrived lukewarm. Overall, the slow service and atmosphere really took away from what could have been a much better experience I’ve experienced at other branches. And I hope there’s improvement as it goes on.

reviews.author: Rex Lapis
reviews.text: waited for 1 hour and had to ask the servers when the food would arrive. Turns out they ran out of an ingredient which the chef did not communicate to the servers and we had to place an order again. was given a £20 coupon as compensation but this will probably be used for one per table as they do this with the £5 coupons. Better to go alone

reviews.author: cherryq
reviews.text: Came here with my friends and was planning to use our £5 coupons. Turned out we couldn’t use more than one coupon for one table so ordered anyways. We ordered our food, waited for over an hour and still didn’t get our food. One item on the menu was had ran out and no staff were notified so we ended up waiting for nothing. Absolutely no communication between any of the staff in the kitchen and taking orders. We left without our food and was offered coupons, which they had ready probably because this has happened more than once. Felt completely ignored and I won’t be coming here again.

reviews.author: Hoda Mohamed
reviews.text: Amazing service! Ikran was so kind, helpful and professional. She made the whole experience really easy and comfortable. I’m very happy and would definitely recommend her!

reviews.author: Chelsea Coley
reviews.text: My partner and I visited yesterday and honestly, what a find! 🥢🍜 As it was their opening weekend, there were understandably a few items unavailable from the menu, but that didn’t take away from the experience at all. Everything we did try was absolutely fantastic , full of flavour, beautifully presented, and clearly made with a lot of care. The cocktail deserves a special mention too. Not only was it theatrical and so much fun to watch, but it was genuinely delicious and packed with flavour. 🍸✨ It’s always a bonus when the drinks are just as memorable as the food! One of our favourite little touches was being given the chance to draw our own pictures on Post-it notes and put them up on the wall. Now we have an excuse to come back and see if we can spot ours on our next visit! 📝😂 There’s something really special about discovering a new place while it’s just getting started, and despite a few teething issues that are completely understandable for an opening weekend, the food, atmosphere and little details already made this place stand out. We’re not normally gatekeepers… but we might have to keep this one as our little secret. 🤫❤️ Can’t wait to come back, try more from the menu and see how this place grows. Definitely one to watch!

reviews.author: Yuryana Tang
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our Maki And Ramen experience with my partner and sister. We ordered two Ramen bowls.. the pork Tonkotsu is my favourite with a very creamy broth. And we ordered 3 different types of sushi rolls.. the Black Dragon and Tiger rolls they were both very well made. We will definitely come visit here again. Our server Elham was a very helpful and informative person as she answered all my enquiries while working in a very busy environment.. we want to praise her customer service.

reviews.author: S Ma
reviews.text: Disappointed that only selected dishes were available at a weekend lunchtime. Table wasn’t clean even though they had just opened for service. Service was however friendly, quick and efficient. Food was ok but not all advertised ingredients were included (e.g ramen dish seemed to be missing spring onion and bamboo).
